parts.name: Modal
parts.description: A modal dialog with required title and description. Focus is managed by Radix; outside pointer interaction does not dismiss it. Escape and close actions do.

props.name: trigger
props.description: One ref-capable action element used as the dialog trigger.

props.name: title
props.description: Required visible and accessible dialog title.

props.name: description
props.description: Required visible and accessible dialog description.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the built-in close action.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when opening or closing is requested.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

parts.name: ModalClose
parts.description: Closes the nearest matching overlay. Use asChild with one ref-capable action element, or render the default native button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
